_note: Wording per segment for the one-page assessment proposal. Words only: no rand amounts except the assessment fee, no invented facts about any prospect. A prospect can override any key in prospects.json.

farm.walk: the office, pump stations, irrigation blocks, packhouse and cold rooms, and where people work in the field
farm.systems: pumps, irrigation controllers, cold rooms, cameras and field staff

lenses.cost: A pump, controller or cold-room alarm that reaches nobody shows up as a dry block, lost fruit or a warm room.
lenses.value: Alarms reach the right person, wherever they are on the farm.

lenses.cost: Every check is a bakkie trip to the far end of the farm.
lenses.value: Pumps, tanks, meters and cameras visible from the office and the phone.

lenses.cost: Several LTE routers and contracts, each its own point of failure.
lenses.value: One owned backbone that carries every system you add later.

lenses.cost: Problems are found late, by whoever drives past.
lenses.value: Management sees the whole operation, with a record of what happened and when.

mine.walk: the weighbridge, plant, pit or quarry face, offices, gates and camera positions
mine.systems: the weighbridge, CCTV, access control, plant telemetry and people away from the buildings

lenses.cost: A weighbridge or camera offline is product, fuel or cable leaving without a record.
lenses.value: Weighbridge, CCTV and access control stay up, with a standby path when the main link fails.

lenses.cost: Faults are found by driving out, and trucks queue while the weighbridge is down.
lenses.value: Engineering sees plant telemetry from anywhere on site.

lenses.cost: A patchwork of links that grew site by site, each with its own supplier.
lenses.value: One owned, monitored network with one number to call when something drops.

lenses.cost: Incidents on site with no reliable way to reach people or evidence what happened.
lenses.value: Dependable communications for safety, incident response and audit.

reserve.walk: the lodges and camps, the gates, ranger and anti-poaching positions, and the high ground
reserve.systems: guest Wi-Fi and payments, ranger and staff communications, gates and cameras

lenses.cost: Gaps in coverage sit exactly where incidents happen: fences, gates and the far side of the reserve.
lenses.value: Cameras, gates and alarms report in, after hours as well.

lenses.cost: Staff drive to find each other, and every fault needs a vehicle and a person.
lenses.value: Rangers, guides and maintenance teams reachable across the property.

lenses.cost: Rented links per lodge, paid for month after month, still with gaps.
lenses.value: A reserve-owned backbone that carries guests, staff and security on one network.

lenses.cost: An incident after hours with no effective way to coordinate.
lenses.value: Dependable communications across the areas where an incident can happen.

reserve.proof: At Sandymount Safaris (30,000+ ha, three lodges) an owned backbone took daily provider callouts to zero and carries over 800 Mbps across the reserve.

wind.walk: the substation and control room, turbine strings, O&M buildings, perimeter cameras and existing fibre routes
wind.systems: SCADA, O&M crews, perimeter cameras and site offices

lenses.cost: When the fibre is cut or stolen, SCADA and the perimeter cameras go dark together.
lenses.value: A standby wireless path that takes over automatically.

lenses.cost: Crews lose time where cellular coverage is patchy.
lenses.value: Turbine data and reporting available across the site.

lenses.cost: A single path with no owned fallback.
lenses.value: An owned, monitored standby network under your control.

lenses.cost: Lost visibility becomes an availability and reporting problem.
lenses.value: Evidence of resilience for the asset owner and the grid.

forestry.walk: the mills, fire lookout and camera positions, compartments where crews work, and the high ground
forestry.systems: fire-detection cameras, crew safety in the compartments and the mills

lenses.cost: In fire season, a camera or radio link that drops is a fire nobody sees in time.
lenses.value: Fire-detection cameras that stay connected.

lenses.cost: Supervisors drive to check on crews and sites.
lenses.value: Crews, mills and cameras reachable across the plantations.

lenses.cost: Coverage depends on whatever cellular signal reaches the compartment.
lenses.value: An owned network with coverage where the crews and the fire risk are.

lenses.cost: A crew in trouble that cannot call out.
lenses.value: Dependable communications for crew safety and incident response.
